changes: Added a "Restart high-memory streams" quick tool that restarts live streams using over 750 MB of memory.
Fixed two monitors starting the same stream at once killing each other's producer: a stream's (re)start now runs under a per-stream lock.
Bounded ffmpeg's interleave buffer to 10 s instead of disabling it, so a live source with a stalled audio track no longer grows ffmpeg's memory until the OOM killer strikes.
On-demand streams now honor their probe settings, and bulk line edits refresh the line cache.
The player API returns a live stream's "added" field as a string, from the cache and the database alike.
Legacy MPEG-TS viewers stay connected across a short producer restart.
Reseller renewals commit the line and its cache refresh in one transaction, and reseller saves refresh the cached line, so authentication no longer reads the old expiry.

Legacy database migration no longer reports success after a partial import or throws away its source: failed imports exit with an error and keep the source data, a lock prevents concurrent imports, an interrupted cleanup blocks unsafe retries, and large imports query table metadata once per table instead of once per row.
Fixed Add/Save doing nothing on mobile for lines, MAG devices and Enigma2 devices after an expiry date was changed.

Serve-only load balancers: the install fetches the fanout daemon as well as the agent, certbot runs root-owned through the node helper and hands the certificate to the front, and a reinstall keeps the node's fanout and certbot configuration and its certificate.
Load balancers can run module source drivers that opt in to them.
Fixed a serve-only node's stale fanout status being carried into its watchdog data, which kept restarting the release canary.
The cache page counts streams per type (live, movies, episodes, ...) and flags rows whose type no page lists.

Fixed badges in admin data tables being hard to read, the reseller customizer theme not being saved, an undefined-array-key warning when listing backups, and blocked user agents being checked against the wrong column when saved.
M3U imports drop entries that have no path (m3u-parser 6.2); m3u-parser updated to 6.2.0 and mobiledetectlib to 4.11.0.
